title: Use of the Content-Disposition Header Field in the Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP)
summary: RFC 2616 mentioned Content-Disposition but said it was not part of HTTP/1.1. This standards-track document takes over its definition for HTTP and clarifies internationalization. It is the header used to suggest file names for downloads.

eli5.summary: A server can say save this as a file with this name. This writes down exactly how to say that, including names with accents.

questions: how to suggest download filename in http
